sonnet.problem: Verse 11 gets no story card or setup, and the question asks what God has made known to David. The baker can't reason this out. It comes down to guessing the wording of the line, 'the path of life', against two made-up alternatives.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.

sonnet.problem: The card says David is 'not taking part in ANY of it'. The text only says he won't pour out their libations of blood or speak their names. The all-encompassing claim stretches the text, and it sits in the storyteller line, not in a joke.
sonnet.rule: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.
